messages.content: Joint screen/speech grounding. Read actual PNGs, full transcript, original event coordinates/time and prior accepted binding. The overlaid cross/path and event IDs visualize raw observations; they are NOT inferred targets. Original coordinates are frame pixels with supplied width/height. Identify exact visible item/sample IDs for each expression. For corrections preserve the explicitly retained binding, revise replaced bindings, recheck the complete set. Historic pointing remains on its original frame after navigation. A loop may designate plotted samples. You own both target extents and final binding. Do not perform the business task. The intent MUST state the USER requested action and topic/scope (such as comparing performance or averaging selected samples), not your internal bind/identify/grounding operation. Ground the action in the actual full transcript; name adopted targets in the adoptions, not as a substitute for the user action. Return ONLY compact JSON: {intent:string,adoptions:[{expression_id:string,targets:[visible_id],status:'ready'|'ambiguous'|'need_evidence',count:integer|null,relation:'point_inside'|'within_region'|'relative_position'|'retain_prior'|'other',cue_ids:[event_id],extents:[{target_id,frame_id,label:visible_header_max60chars,bbox:[x1,y1,x2,y2]}],evidence:string}],need_evidence:false|{scope:string}}. Each expression once, count is the number required by speech when explicit; IDs must be visible, bbox in original frame pixels and within frame bounds. A point-inside coordinate must fall in chosen bbox. For loop sample sets, each sample bbox center must be in the raw polygon. Request source reread or mark unresolved on contradiction. Evidence max100 characters, intent max120 characters; no chain-of-thought or extra reasoning fields. Any auxiliary parser data is fallible derived interpretation, never truth; verify original pixels/events. Relation/event contract (same for all roles): point_inside means a raw pointer_move event's (x,y) point lies INSIDE the TARGET bbox [x1,y1,x2,y2]; it does NOT mean a plotted sample point lies inside a loop. within_region means a raw pointer_path event is a CLOSED polygon (at least4points, final endpoint within2pixels of first) and each selected TARGET bbox CENTER lies inside that raw polygon. For a loop-enclosed set of plotted points use within_region, never point_inside. designated_by_cue is the speech producer's generic designation and follows the cited raw event type: pointer_move checks pointer-in-target-bbox, pointer_path checks target-center-in-closed-polygon. Use only relations allowed by your role's output schema. Read event.type and original frame coordinates; do not infer type from a cue ID's spelling. If a path is open or its designation is ambiguous, request owner evidence or return unresolved; do not use other/relative_position to evade a geometric claim. This contract supplies no target IDs or target geometry. Return valid JSON only.
